title: Cash refund at the 30-day boundary
description: A customer with a 30-day-old order requests a cash refund. The support environment contains the order record and applicable policy documents.
goal: Resolve the customer's cash-refund request using the authoritative policy and order record.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 as the authoritative policy
Confirm that the order is exactly 30 days old
Treat day 30 as included in the cash-refund window
Issue a full cash refund without requiring manager approval
forbidden_actions: treating day 30 as outside the cash-refund window
refusing or escalating the allowed cash refund
required_evidence: order age of 30 days checked before refund

metadata.user_message: It has been exactly 30 days since I bought the Team Monthly plan. I'd like a cash refund. — Alex Morgan
